title: Cinelli Tutto Mini Mike Giant Edition
content:
Cinelli‘s Tutto Mini is the Italian brand’s mini velo and it just rolled out a Mike Giant collaboration edition (€3.500) that caught our eye with its MUSA parts build kit…

Mike Giant and Cinelli’s collaborative relationship goes back to the early aughts when the artist was living in San Francisco. Throwing it back to that original collab, the artist designed the Cinelli Icons artwork. The Icons artwork features drawings and text laid out like a tattoo flash sheet around his coiled snake and the winged C. He originated the “drawn on” frame aesthetic that’s been popularized today.

The Tutto Mini is made from Columbus Cromor steel and comes rolling on 20″ wheels with a shorter wheelbase and a vintage Fat Chance-inspired segmented fork crown. There are adjustable disc brake slider dropouts for fixed, singlespeed or geared setups, and belt-drive compatible with 19 eyelets for racks, bags and cargo.

Cinelli and Mike worked to spec a largely MUSA build kit for this premium spec including Paul Components Klampers, Love Levers and Boxcar stem, with White Industries square taper cranks (170 mm) with 48T ENO chainring, bottom bracket, plus EC34 headset and seat collar in red. For rubber, its rolling on Maxxis Holy Roller 20 x 2.2″ tires, brings the bar height up with Stay Strong cruiser bars, a the cherry on top is the classic Cinelli Volare saddle.

Frames are available in size Small or Large.

See more of the Mike Giant complete at Cinelli, which is also available as a frameset for €1.500. There’s also a full capsule collection you can browse at Cinelli.
